C.2112.v: Loyola University Maryland began offering Early Decision starting with the Fall 2024 application cycle. Both Early Decision I and Early Decision II are binding plans for academically strong students who have identified Loyola as their first-choice institution. Admitted Early Decision students enjoy a number of exclusive advantages, including priority consideration for admission, merit scholarships, and need-based financial aid. Additional benefits include priority selection of Summer Orientation sessions, preferred residential room type selection ahead of the general incoming class, early access to an academic advisor, early course registration, priority choice of move-in time, and a personalized shadow day with a current Loyola student in their area of interest. Commuter students admitted through Early Decision receive free parking in lieu of priority housing selection.
